# raseeda

> raseeda is a free, private invoice generator that runs entirely in the browser. There is no account and nothing is uploaded: invoices are saved in the browser on the user's device (IndexedDB), the PDF is made on the device, and invoice content leaves it only in files the user saves. The site counts anonymous usage (event names, country, browser family, OS, device type, language, the kind of site a visit came from, and a few bucketed invoice details such as the currency code, never names or amounts) with no cookies or identifiers. Automated browsers, and pages a script drives through the editor's API, aren't counted. It is open source under the MIT licence.

## For AI agents

The fastest way to make a document is the editor's on-device API, not clicking:

1. Open https://raseeda.com/create and wait for `window.raseeda` to exist.
2. `const id = await raseeda.createInvoice(data)`, where `data` follows the [invoice JSON Schema](https://raseeda.com/invoice.schema.json). Every field is optional.
3. `await raseeda.downloadPdf(id)` saves the PDF, or `await raseeda.getPdf(id)` returns it as a Blob.

```js
const id = await raseeda.createInvoice({
  number: "INV-0042",
  invoiceDate: "2026-11-26",
  seller: { content: "Jane Designs\n1 Market St\nLondon" },
  client: { content: "Acme Ltd\n1 High Street\nLeeds" },
  currency: "£",
  items: [{ description: "Design work", quantity: 10, unit: "hrs", unitPrice: 80 }],
  tax: { percentage: 20 }
});
await raseeda.downloadPdf(id);
```

- [Agent guide](https://raseeda.com/llms-full.txt): every call, the data's rules (document types, tax, languages, number formats, payment details), more examples, and the controls to use when an agent can only click
- [Invoice JSON Schema](https://raseeda.com/invoice.schema.json): the exact shape `createInvoice` takes, with each field's allowed values and default

Invoices are kept in the browser that made them. An automated browser that starts with empty storage keeps nothing between sessions, so download the PDF before it closes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://raseeda.com/): what raseeda does, how it compares with other invoice generators and accounting software, what goes on the invoice, and common questions
- [Invoice editor](https://raseeda.com/create): create, edit and download an invoice as an A4 or Letter PDF (requires JavaScript)
- [Invoice templates](https://raseeda.com/invoice-template): sample invoices for freelance, consulting, small business, contractor, photography and web development work, each opening the editor in its font
- [Quote template](https://raseeda.com/quote-template), [proforma invoice template](https://raseeda.com/proforma-invoice-template), [receipt template](https://raseeda.com/receipt-template) and [credit note template](https://raseeda.com/credit-note-template): each opens the editor with that document type ready
- [Freelance](https://raseeda.com/freelance-invoice-template), [contractor](https://raseeda.com/contractor-invoice-template) and [retail](https://raseeda.com/retail-invoice-template) invoice templates: each opens the editor laid out for that trade (hours and a rate; labour, materials and a job site; a tax rate on each line)
- [Privacy](https://raseeda.com/privacy): what raseeda stores, where, and what never leaves the device
- [Terms of use](https://raseeda.com/terms): free and provided as is; what goes on an invoice is the user's responsibility

## Facts

- Free, with no paid plan, no ads and no watermark on the PDF.
- No account and no sign-up.
- Invoices, quotes, proforma invoices, receipts and credit notes, each with its own title, labels and closing rows (a quote ends on its total, a receipt shows its total as paid, a credit note names the invoice it refers to). Any of them can be duplicated as another type, such as a quote as an invoice, and the library shows and filters each document's type.
- Any currency, VAT or sales tax, fees, discounts, payment details (bank, account and routing numbers, IBAN, BIC / SWIFT, sort code, each under a label you can rename, and other ways to pay such as PayPal, Venmo, Pix or UPI), templates for repeat clients, and import / export backups.
- raseeda makes the PDF; it does not email invoices or track payments.
- No server API and no server-side storage: the editor's API runs on the device and sends nothing anywhere.
